resources.string: Offline AI noise removal for your voice recordings
Turn off to hear the original and compare
AI removes fan, AC, traffic, people talking, claps, knocks, footsteps, dogs and hiss. 80–100% recommended.
Crisper speech, evens out quiet and loud words. 30–50% recommended.
Up to 5x louder, with a limiter so it never crackles
Saves a copy with your current settings. The original is not changed.
Off: AI keeps only voices and removes every other sound.
On: keeps voices, claps, contact sounds and breathing. Removes only steady noise (fan, AC, hiss, hum).
Removes fan, AC, hiss and hum. All other sounds stay. 70–100% recommended.
Brings soft sounds up closer to the loud ones. 40–70% recommended.
